gates.name: leakage_clean
gates.rationale: No fatal leakage detected. 0 non-fatal warning(s) raised. A clean result here is only as strong as the list of checks that could actually run; see the limitations band.

gates.name: beats_benchmark_net
gates.rationale: No alpha over buy-and-hold after costs. Strategy returned 12.89% CAGR net of everything against -20.42% for the benchmark, beta 0.12. Annualised alpha 0.40% with a t-stat of 0.31 (Newey-West, 6 lags) over 504 observations; threshold is 2.0, and alpha with a t-stat below 2 is not alpha.

gates.name: deflated_sharpe
gates.rationale: The probability the true Sharpe exceeds zero, after adjusting for how many variants were tried and for the shape of the return distribution, is 0.37 against a threshold of 0.95. Adjusted for selection, this is a search finding noise.

gates.name: reality_check
gates.rationale: Bootstrapping the null that the best candidate does not beat the benchmark, using a stationary bootstrap so autocorrelation survives resampling, gives p = 0.095 against a threshold of 0.050. The outperformance is within what chance produces on this history.

gates.name: walkforward_consistency
gates.rationale: Net-positive after costs in 3 of 5 out-of-sample folds (60%) against a threshold of 60%. The result is spread across folds rather than carried by one.

gates.name: sensitivity_plateau
gates.rationale: The mean Sharpe of the immediate parameter neighbourhood is 23% of the peak (0.19 against 0.82), threshold 60%. A spike is curve-fitting: the result depends on the exact parameters chosen, and neighbouring values do not work.

gates.name: capacity
gates.rationale: Not computable: Evidence carries no per-order ADV participation, so the share of daily traded volume this strategy would consume cannot be checked. Order-level participation data is required. This gate did not judge the strategy either way. It does not count as a pass -- a strategy cannot clear a test that was never run -- but it is reported separately from a genuine failure so the difference stays visible.

gates.name: drawdown_tolerance
gates.rationale: Maximum peak-to-trough decline was 11.7% against a tolerance of 35.0%, with the longest underwater period lasting 109 bars. Within tolerance.
